name: Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi
englishBachelors: Four bachelor's degrees are taught in English: Physics (Quantum Technologies), Mathematics (Data Science for AI), Records Management and Archival Science, and COAST. The other bachelor's pages checked are taught in French.
note: A Sorbonne campus on Al Reem Island awarding French degrees, and a real option if you have French. Its art history and museology programmes connect directly to the Louvre Abu Dhabi, but check the language of instruction carefully: this is not an English-medium university.
summary: French degrees awarded by Sorbonne Université on Al Reem Island; four bachelor's are taught in English, the rest in French and needing a B2 French certificate.
about: Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi follows the European ECTS system and its degrees are accredited by the UAE Commission for Academic Accreditation. English-taught degrees ask for an English proof unless you are exempt.

ib.text: Direct entry needs the IB with 28 of 42 points, at least 4 of 7 in each subject and three Higher Level subjects. Course Results are not described. Some degrees add Maths or English rules.

notes: Language: only four bachelor's pages state English as the delivery language: Physics (Quantum Technologies), Mathematics (Data Science for AI), Records Management and Archival Science, and COAST. Law, Economics and Management, History, Philosophy and Sociology, History of Art, HAPAC and Business and Foreign Languages are delivered in French and need a French B2 certificate (DELF/DALF, TCF, TEF or SELFEE) or the university's French diploma, unless you hold a French Baccalaureate. The Geography and Planning page could not be loaded to confirm its language. Foundation years are not degrees and are not listed.

IB entry: 28/42 with 4/7 in each subject and three HL subjects, from the admissions FAQ. Some programmes add Maths or English rules and the programme requirement tabs did not load, so check each programme page. SAT Maths can substitute for the maths requirement for Physics and Mathematics. No rule for IB Course Results is published.

English proof: needed for Physics, Mathematics, Records Management and COAST unless exempt (for example a curriculum studied in English, or 80% in English for UAE Ministry of Education students). Whether an IB English course qualifies is not stated; the English test scores for undergraduates are not given on the pages checked.

Dates: the 2026/27 deadline for all undergraduate programmes was 21 August 2026, and the page lists no later round. The September 2027 deadline is not published; it is shown as last year's date only. Apply early, as soon as first-term Grade 12 results are out. The offer must be accepted two weeks before the academic year starts.

Costs: AED 200 non-refundable application fee. Tuition is AED 215,100 over three years including admin fees for Physics, Mathematics and Records Management (2026/27 programme pages); COAST is listed as TBC. 2027/28 fees are not published.

Documents: transcripts of the last two years of school, diploma, a personal statement in English or French of 400 to 500 words depending on the degree language, passport and photo. UAE equivalency of the school certificate and attestation are required, with conditional admission possible while these are pending.
